product: Upcoming end of life for the Genie One MCP Beta endpoint
tagline: The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint, https://<workspace hostname /api/2.0/mcp/genie, reaches end of life on November 30, 2026.
what_it_does: The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint, https://<workspace hostname /api/2.0/mcp/genie, reaches end of life on November 30, 2026. After that date, requests to the Beta endpoint fail. The end of life date was previously October 31, 2026.
why_it_matters: Genie resolves business terms, metric definitions, and table relationships through Genie Ontology, your governed semantic layer, which produces more accurate answers than an agent writing SQL directly against raw tables.
plain_summary: The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint, https://<workspace hostname /api/2.0/mcp/genie, reaches end of life on November 30, 2026. After that date, requests to the Beta endpoint fail.
key_takeaway: The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint, https://<workspace hostname /api/2.0/mcp/genie, reaches end of life on November 30, 2026.
